title: shabby white TV tray stand
text: shabby white TV tray stand. The product is quite lightweight and has no top to the folding table legs other than the tray. I wiggles on my carpeted bedroom floor and I can put any thing beyond a coffee cup and a snack tray on it for fear it will tip over. There are ribbons that hold the bottom feet from collapsing and I'm concerned that as those ribbons age and deteriorate, the table will not be functional at all. I'm kicking myself for purchasing this when I could have had something much more stable for ten dollars more. This will move into the bathroom for lightweight toiletry bottles once I've gotten something more stable.

product_metadata.title: Elegant Shabby White Tv Television Breakfast Tray Stand
description: Gracious entertaining is a snap with this stylish tray table! Elegantly aged white finish with a carved rim and two handy drawers; folding legs for easy storage. Contents not included.
